# Implementation Status Log

Track coding exercises, analyses, pipelines, dashboards, and projects. Create
one entry per independently reviewable task and update that entry as work
progresses. Use sequential IDs (`IMPL-001`, `IMPL-002`, ...); preserve history
and never report planned or unexecuted validation as completed.

The coach should tick checklist boxes as the corresponding work is actually
completed, so the learner can see progress without maintaining the checklist
manually. Leave incomplete work unchecked. For a step that does not apply,
write `N/A` with a brief reason instead of checking it. Never tick a validation
box based only on intended or generated code.

## Status values

- **Planned**: Scope and acceptance criteria are recorded; work has not started.
- **In Progress**: Implementation is underway.
- **Blocked**: Work cannot continue; record the reason and any needed input.
- **Needs Review**: Implementation is ready for review or validation is
  incomplete.
- **Completed**: Acceptance criteria are met and completed validation is
  recorded.

#### Implementation checklist

- [ ] Scope and acceptance criteria agreed
- [ ] Relevant data, files, or project conventions inspected
- [ ] Implementation completed
- [ ] Relevant tests or checks added or updated
- [ ] Validation actually executed
- [ ] Results reviewed and defects recorded
- [ ] Documentation or explanation completed
- [ ] Acceptance criteria verified

Set **Completed** only when applicable acceptance criteria pass and validation
evidence is recorded. If work is blocked or awaiting execution or review, keep
the relevant boxes unchecked and use the matching status.
